FILTERS.SEARCH: Search by title, name, phone or e-mail

EMPTY.NO_BOARDS_ADMIN: Create a board to track deals from conversations in any inbox.
EMPTY.NO_BOARDS_AGENT: No board has been shared with you. Ask an administrator to create one.

COLUMN.TOTAL_VALUE: Total of the deals in this stage

CARD.RESTRICTED_CONVERSATION: Conversation from an inbox you cannot access
CARD.AUTOMATIC_HINT: Opened by a new conversation. Goes away once someone reviews the deal.

CARD_FORM.TITLE: Title
CARD_FORM.TITLE_PLACEHOLDER: Leave blank to use the contact's name
CARD_FORM.CONTACT_SEARCH: Type a name, phone or e-mail
CARD_FORM.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete this card? Conversations are not affected.
CARD_FORM.AUTOMATIC_NOTICE: Opened automatically by a new conversation. Check the title, the assignee and the value.
CARD_FORM.STALE: Stalled for {days} days in this stage
CARD_FORM.EXPECTED_CLOSE_HINT: Used by the report’s revenue forecast.

BOARD_FORM.NAME: Name
BOARD_FORM.VISIBILITY_HINT: With no inboxes and no teams, every agent sees the board. Administrators always do.
BOARD_FORM.STAGES_HINT: Drag to reorder. Won and Lost stages close the deal.
BOARD_FORM.STAGES_AUTOSAVE: Stage changes are saved right away.
BOARD_FORM.DEFAULT_STAGES_HINT: The board starts with the stages New, In progress, Won and Lost. You can adjust them afterwards.
BOARD_FORM.DELETE_STAGE_EMPTY: This stage has no cards. It will be removed from the board.
BOARD_FORM.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete the board "{name}" and all its cards? Conversations are not affected.
BOARD_FORM.STALE_INVALID: Use a whole number from 1 to 365, or leave it empty for no alert.
BOARD_FORM.CHANCE_INVALID: Use a whole number from 0 to 100, or leave it empty for the default.

PANEL.TITLE: Kanban
PANEL.NONE: This conversation is not on any card.

ERRORS.GENERIC: Could not complete that. Please try again.
ERRORS.MOVE: Could not move the card. The board was reloaded.

VALUE.AMOUNT_HINT: Without products, type the value. With products, it becomes their sum.
VALUE.FROM_ITEMS: Sum of the products. To type a value, remove the products.
VALUE.EMPTY_CATALOG_AGENT: The catalog is empty. Ask an administrator to add products.
VALUE.ITEM_INVALID: Check quantity, price and discount (0 to 100%).

SUMMARY.LABEL: Funnel summary
SUMMARY.OPEN_HINT: Deals in open stages right now, created at any time.
SUMMARY.WON_HINT: Deals that entered a won stage in the period and are still there.
SUMMARY.LOST_HINT: Deals that entered a lost stage in the period and are still there.
SUMMARY.WIN_RATE_HINT: Won over all deals closed (won and lost) in the period.
SUMMARY.AVERAGE_WON_HINT: Average value of the deals won in the period.
SUMMARY.CYCLE_HINT: Average time from creation to win, for the deals won in the period.

FUNNEL.TITLE: Funnel for the period
FUNNEL.DESCRIPTION: Of the {count} deals created in the period, how many reached each stage or went past it.
FUNNEL.REACHED_HINT: Deals created in the period that entered this stage or a later one. A won deal went through every open stage.
FUNNEL.CONVERSION_HINT: Share of the previous stage that got here. On the first stage, share of the deals created in the period.
FUNNEL.NOW_HINT: Deals and value in this stage right now.
FUNNEL.TIME_HINT: How long deals stayed in the stage before leaving, for the exits in the period.

REPORT.EMPTY_TITLE: No deals created in this period
REPORT.EMPTY_BODY: The funnel counts the deals created in the period. Pick a longer period or create cards on the board.
REPORT.HISTORY_NOTE: Stage history started being recorded in this version. Older deals only count the stage they were in at that moment.
REPORT.ERROR: The report could not be loaded.

FORECAST.TITLE: Revenue forecast
FORECAST.DESCRIPTION: Open deals by expected close month. The weighted value counts each stage’s chance.
FORECAST.EMPTY_BODY: When there are open deals, the forecast shows here.
FORECAST.WEIGHTED_HINT: Each deal’s value times the chance of winning of its stage.
FORECAST.COVERAGE: {withDate} of {total} open deals have an expected date

LOST_REASONS.TITLE: Lost reasons
LOST_REASONS.DESCRIPTION: Why the period’s deals were lost.
LOST_REASONS.EMPTY_TITLE: No deals lost in the period
LOST_REASONS.EMPTY_BODY: When there are, the reasons show here.

PRODUCTS.DESCRIPTION: The catalog agents use to build the value of the deals on the Kanban. Changing or deactivating a product never changes the deals that already have it.
PRODUCTS.EMPTY_BODY: Add the products and services you sell. They show up to pick from when building the value of a deal.
PRODUCTS.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete "{name}" from the catalog? Deals that already have it keep their copy.

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.ACTIVE_HINT: When off, it leaves the card search but stays on the deals that already have it.

CURRENCY.LABEL: Deal currency
CURRENCY.HINT: Applies to every Kanban value in this account. Changing it does not convert values already entered.

TASKS.EMPTY: No tasks. Schedule the next step of this deal.
TASKS.TITLE: Task title
TASKS.TITLE_PLACEHOLDER: E.g. Call to confirm the quote
TASKS.FAILED: The task could not be saved.

AUTOMATIONS.HINT: Let the board work on its own: when something happens to a deal, rules act in the order they were created.
AUTOMATIONS.EMPTY: Start from one of these templates and adjust it.

TRIGGER_HINT.DEAL_CREATED: Applies to every new deal, made by hand or by a conversation.
TRIGGER_HINT.DEAL_STALLED: Fires when a deal passes its stage’s day limit. Set the limit on each stage.

AUTOMATIONS.LABEL: Label
AUTOMATIONS.HOURS_HINT: From 1 to 720 hours, counted from the last message.
AUTOMATIONS.DUE_HINT: 0 is due right away; 48 is due in 2 days.

PROBLEMS.LABEL: Choose a label.
PROBLEMS.HOURS: Use a whole number from {min} to {max}.
PROBLEMS.TITLE: Give the task a title.
PROBLEMS.DUE: Use a whole number from {min} to {max}.

AUTOMATIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM: This rule stops acting: {rule} Deals stay as they are.

NEEDS_ATTENTION.LABEL: Needs attention
NEEDS_ATTENTION.AGENT_MISSING: the chosen agent is no longer on the account

AUTOMATIONS.RUNS_EMPTY: When a rule acts, you will see here what it did.

TRIGGER_TEXT.DEAL_STALLED: a deal passes its stage limit
TRIGGER_TEXT.NO_REPLY_CUSTOMER: the customer is silent for {hours} h
TRIGGER_TEXT.NO_REPLY_AGENT: the team leaves the customer unanswered for {hours} h

REASONS.ALREADY_THERE: it was already in that stage
REASONS.AGENT_CANNOT_SEE_BOARD: the agent cannot see this board
REASONS.ALREADY_LABELLED: the conversation already had the label

STARTERS.WON_WHEN_RESOLVED: Won when the conversation is resolved
STARTERS.WON_WHEN_RESOLVED_HINT: Moves the deal to the won stage.
STARTERS.CHASE_SILENT_CUSTOMER_HINT: Creates a task after 24 h without a customer reply.
STARTERS.FIRST_CONTACT_HINT: Creates a task for the deal’s agent on every new deal.

UNKNOWN.STAGE: a stage that no longer exists
UNKNOWN.AGENT: an agent who is no longer on the account

NOTIFICATIONS.TITLE: Notifications
NOTIFICATIONS.EMPTY_TEXT: You will be told here when a task falls due, a deal or a task is handed to you, or an automation moves a deal of yours.

KINDS.TASK_ASSIGNED: A task was assigned to you
KINDS.CARD_ASSIGNED: A deal was assigned to you
KINDS.CARD_MOVED: An automation moved the deal to {stage}

MY_TASKS.EMPTY_TEXT: Schedule the next step of a deal in its card panel, under Tasks.
MY_TASKS.ERROR_TITLE: The tasks could not be loaded
MY_TASKS.ERROR_TEXT: Check the connection and try again.

AUTO_CREATE.HINT: A new conversation from a contact with no open deal on this board opens one on its own.
AUTO_CREATE.NEEDS_INBOX: Pick at least one inbox to turn it on.
AUTO_CREATE.RULE_STAGE: The deal lands on the first open stage, with the conversation linked.
AUTO_CREATE.RULE_DEDUP: A contact who already has an open deal on this board gets no second one.
AUTO_CREATE.RULE_ASSIGNEE: The assignee is the conversation’s agent, when there is one; they are told in the bell.

LOST.TITLE: Why was this deal lost?
LOST.DESCRIPTION: It helps the team see what to do differently. You can skip it.
LOST.EMPTY: No reasons yet. An administrator creates the list in Settings → Kanban.
LOST.LOAD_FAILED: The reasons could not be loaded. You can still mark it with no reason.

HISTORY.ERROR: The history could not be loaded.
HISTORY.CREATED_AUTOMATIC: Deal opened by a new conversation, in {stage}

QUOTE.BUTTON_HINT: Builds the message from the products above.
QUOTE.TITLE: Send quote
QUOTE.DESCRIPTION: The message goes to the conversation’s reply box. You review it and send.
QUOTE.TOO_LONG: Over {max} characters, the limit of one message. Shorten the text.
QUOTE.NO_LINES: Add products to the deal to build a quote.
QUOTE.NO_CONVERSATION: Link a conversation to this deal to send the quote.
QUOTE.FAILED: The quote could not be taken to the conversation.

SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Lost reasons and the account’s quote message.
SETTINGS.LOAD_FAILED: The settings could not be loaded.

LOST_REASONS.TITLE: Lost reasons
LOST_REASONS.DESCRIPTION: The options agents see when they mark a deal as lost.
LOST_REASONS.EMPTY_BODY: Create the most common ones, such as price, delivery time or a competitor.
LOST_REASONS.NAME: Reason name
LOST_REASONS.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete “{name}”? Deals lost for it stay lost, only without a reason. This cannot be undone.

QUOTE.TITLE: Quote message
QUOTE.DESCRIPTION: The text agents take to the conversation when they send a quote.
QUOTE.EMPTY_IS_DEFAULT: Empty uses the default message, in each agent’s language.

WEBHOOKS.TITLE: Webhooks
WEBHOOKS.DESCRIPTION: Tell another system when something happens to a deal. Applies to every board of the account; each delivery is signed with a secret.
WEBHOOKS.DELETE_CONFIRM: {url} stops receiving events. Its delivery history is deleted too.
WEBHOOKS.EMPTY_BODY: Add an https address to hear about deals created, moved, won or lost.
WEBHOOKS.LIMIT: An account can have up to {max} webhooks.
WEBHOOKS.URL_HINT: Must start with https://. Local and internal network addresses are not accepted.

PROBLEMS.URL_HTTPS: Use a full address, starting with https://

ERRORS.BLOCKED_ADDRESS: The address points to an internal network and was blocked.
ERRORS.UNRESOLVED_HOST: The address could not be found.
ERRORS.WEBHOOK_OFF: The webhook was turned off before sending.

LOG.TITLE: Latest deliveries
LOG.EMPTY: Nothing was sent yet. Use “Send test” to check the address.

SECRET.TITLE: Save the secret now
SECRET.DESCRIPTION: It will not be shown again. The receiver uses it to check the event came from here.
SECRET.COPY_FAILED: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
SECRET.HOW: Each delivery carries the X-Flow-Signature header (t=time,v1=signature). The signature is the HMAC-SHA256 of “time.body” with this secret.

DATA.TITLE: Import and export
DATA.DESCRIPTION: Bring products and deals from a spreadsheet into the Kanban, or download them as CSV. Nothing is written before you check it.
DATA.PRODUCTS_HINT: The account catalog. Importing the same file again duplicates nothing: the SKU (or the name, without a SKU) identifies a product.
DATA.DEALS_HINT: The deals of one board. The contact is found by e-mail or phone; a deal with the same title for the same contact is skipped.

INTRO.PRODUCTS: Choose a CSV file with the products. The first line must name the columns: name, SKU, unit and price.
INTRO.DEALS: Choose a CSV file with the deals. The first line must name the columns; each deal needs the contact’s e-mail or phone.

IMPORT.LIMITS: Up to {mb} MB and {rows} rows, UTF-8, separated by comma or semicolon.
IMPORT.NOTHING_YET: You check the columns and the rows before anything is written.

FILE_PROBLEM.TYPE: The file must be a CSV (.csv).

IMPORT.COLUMNS_HINT: Check which column of the file is each field. When you change one, the rows are read again.
IMPORT.PROBLEMS: {count} row with a problem | {count} rows with problems
IMPORT.PROBLEMS_HINT: These rows are left out. The others are imported and you can download the problem ones afterwards.
IMPORT.MORE_PROBLEMS: And {count} more. All of them are in the error file.
IMPORT.CAN_LEAVE: You can close this window: the import keeps going in the background.
IMPORT.RESULT_SUMMARY: {created} created, {updated} updated, {skipped} unchanged and {errors} with errors.
IMPORT.FAILED_BODY: Something went wrong and the import stopped. What was already written stays; you can try again with the same file without duplicating.

AI.HINT: Ask for a draft of what is going on in this deal and a suggested next task. Only what you can see yourself in the linked conversations goes to the assistant.
AI.NO_CONVERSATIONS: Link a conversation to the deal to be able to summarize it.
AI.GENERATING: The assistant is reading the deal…
AI.USED_PARTIAL: Conversations: {conversations} · Messages: {messages}. Only the most recent: the rest did not fit.
AI.REVIEW: It is a draft: check it before using it.
AI.SAVE_HINT: The text goes into the card’s description; save the card to keep it.
AI.TOO_LONG: It does not fit the description (up to 5,000 characters). Shorten the summary.
AI.ADDED: Summary added to the description. Save the card to keep it.

ERRORS.FAILED: The assistant could not answer now. Nothing was changed; try again in a moment.
ERRORS.NETWORK: Could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.

DETAILS.ATTRIBUTES_HINT: Free information on the deal (name and value). The AI agents read and write here too.
DETAILS.READ_ONLY: This value is a list or an object: it stays as it is.

PROBLEMS.KEY_EMPTY: Every attribute with a value needs a name.
PROBLEMS.DUPLICATE: Two attributes have the same name.
PROBLEMS.DATES_ORDER: The start cannot be after the due date.
